phone_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the phone

pending_email.description: New e-mail address waiting for its confirmation link (valid one hour); `email` stays the current address until then. Absent or `null` when there is none

current_password.description: Current password of the account, required when `email` changes the current address

font_family.description: Font of the interface: `system`, `geist`, `atkinson` (Atkinson Hyperlegible) or `lora` (MAIR-1128); `null` resets it

current_session_id.description: Id of the session of the request, never offered to the disconnection

enabled.description: Whether the account is protected by a second factor.

backup_codes_remaining.description: Backup codes not spent yet; 0 when the second factor is off.

secret.description: Base32 secret to type in the authenticator application.

otpauth_uri.description: otpauth:// URI to render as a QR code.

code.description: Six-digit code of the authenticator application, or a backup code.
Six-digit code of the authenticator application, or a backup code.

backup_codes.description: Ten single-use codes (`xxxx-xxxx`), shown once: they cannot be read again.

label.description: Name the agent gave to the passkey.

provider.description: Name of the passkey manager Core deduced from the authenticator (iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, ...), `null` when unknown.

last_used_at.description: Last sign-in with this passkey (ISO 8601), `null` when never used.

options.description: WebAuthn `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` for `navigator.credentials.create` (user verification required, passkeys already registered excluded).

label.description: Name of the passkey, to recognise it in the list.

credential.description: The `PublicKeyCredential` returned by `navigator.credentials.create`, in its WebAuthn JSON form. Forwarded as is: Core verifies it.

session_history.description: First page of the history after the change, newest first

new_password.description: New password, 8 to 255 characters, different from the current one
